uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

512-950-7203.easyPrerequisites: Brigid and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
512-950-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Brigid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-7203.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Brigid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

3899-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

728-3284-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-3284-4550-4871.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1170-4985-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4985-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

5256-7940--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-4478.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7175-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-7175-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7175-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

1806-2060-2921-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1477-6835-6972.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5412-5671.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-5671.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size, one of which must be a land card.
250-779-1479-5412-5671.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard a land and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return a land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

586-5258-5618-5686-7056.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1003-2173-5220-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2173-5073-5220-6634.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1594-4013-4659-5004-6643.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

4222-4324-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
4222-4324-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
4222-4324-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

11-1193-5195-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-1193-5195-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Mythos of Illuna, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Mythos of Illuna, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Mythos of Illuna
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Mythos of Illuna.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Mythos of Illuna to your hand and creating a copy of Mythos of Illuna targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mythos of Illuna copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Mythos of Illuna.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-5223.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-3480-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

5256-6481-6483.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dark Revenant.
When Dark Revenant dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Dark Revenant's power, ultimately milling Dark Revenant.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting Dark Revenant from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1289-1456-5078-5864.notablePrerequisites: Birds of Paradise does not have summoning sickness.
1289-1456-5078-5864.description:
Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

549-1365-2034-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-2034-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

427-913-4067-5766.notablePrerequisites: Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-913-4067-5766.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
If needed, activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Faerie Formation by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.
Eventually, Kydele will produce extra mana, and you may repeat steps 2 and/or 3 as mana allows.

2912-5109.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
Auntie Blyte does not have summoning sickness.
2912-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion triggers.
Resolve the Volcano Hellion trigger, dealing an amount of damage greater than an opponent's life total to you and to any creature besides Auntie Blyte.
Auntie Blyte triggers, causing you to put a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the damage dealt to you.
Activate Auntie Blyte by paying {1}{R}, tapping them, and removing any number of +1/+1 counters from them, dealing that much damage to that opponent.

717-1742-3022.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Darkblast, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's third ability triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Darkblast from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

751-3152.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
751-3152.description:
Activate any creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Shieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

2751-4784-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Dean of Order.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
You control a creature that can attack this turn.
2751-4784-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Strionic Resonator to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Move to your combat phase, and declare any creature you control as an attacker, triggering Augusta.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Augusta's ability.
Resolve the copy of Augusta's ability, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.
